parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) load balancing instance. 

You can invoke the [DescribeRegions](~~443657~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the server group belongs.

parameters.name: ServerGroupIds
parameters.description: The server group IDs. You can query up to 20 server group IDs at a time.

parameters.name: ServerGroupNames
parameters.description: The server group names. You can query up to 20 server group names at a time.

parameters.name: ServerGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

- **Instance**: server type. This type of server group supports adding **Ecs**, **Ens**, and **Eci** instances.
- **Ip**: IP address type. This type of server group supports adding IP addresses directly.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the server group belongs.
